mapper.select: SELECT gs_num, gym_num, available_weekday_start, available_weekday_end, available_weekend_start, available_weekend_end FROM GYM_SCHEDULE WHERE gym_num = #{value}

SELECT ps.id AS id, ps.trainer_id AS trainerId, tu.name AS trainerName, cu.name AS clientName, DATE_FORMAT(ps.start_time, '%H:%i') AS startTime, HOUR(ps.start_time) AS startHour, WEEKDAY(ps.start_time) + 1 AS dayOfWeek, ps.status AS status FROM PT_SESSION ps JOIN TRAINER t ON ps.trainer_id = t.id JOIN USER tu ON t.user_id = tu.id JOIN USER cu ON ps.client_id = cu.id WHERE t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ps.start_time >= #{weekStart} AND ps.start_time < #{weekEnd} AND ps.status != '취소' ORDER BY ps.start_time
